name: slow-consumer-drain
description: The fan-out/fan-in DAG of fan-out-fan-in-dag, read by a consumer that holds every message for a few milliseconds (`client-slow-consumer`, kernel surface). The run emits its last messages and closes the message stream while the consumer holds one, so a stream that stops on `closed` before draining what arrived during the hold drops the final node results and the terminal `job_update` while the run still reports completed (fixed in packages/kernel/src/message-stream.ts). The fault preserves the outcome, so the outputs golden is still compared, and the unfaulted ws-server run must match the slowed kernel oracle frame for frame.
